accepted_claims: Programme-owned durable body and lineage records now have an executable finite-history state machine that never derives authority from kernel/backend topology, tessellation identity, component order, largest-volume selection or proximity matching.

Pure-removal machining has explicit CONTINUE, SPLIT, DISAPPEAR and TOUCH_ONLY transitions: it may preserve, split or exhaust material bodies but cannot merge previously distinct durable bodies, add material or revive an exhausted body.

A split requires a source-bound MC-031 material certificate, an MC-032-compatible event certificate, an independently proved complete pairwise-interior-disjoint remainder partition, exact positive-volume output witnesses and explicit canonical-journal body/lineage assignments.

At most one split output may explicitly continue the parent durable body/lineage; every other positive-volume descendant receives fresh durable body and lineage IDs linked by a programme-owned lineage edge. No size/order/proximity heuristic selects the continuation.
Exact-zero touch records a contact relation while preserving separate durable body identities; touching cannot create removal, connectivity or merge authority.

Complete removal requires independently certified exact empty material and exact zero residual positive volume; the exhausted durable body and lineage record remain present while active material becomes empty. No epsilon residual or placeholder body is invented.
Finite-history application is revision-ordered and fail-closed: stale certificates, non-success terminals, mutated bindings and resource refusal do not mutate canonical durable state.
All authority-path volume witnesses are exact rationals and binary floating point, epsilon, tolerance, timeout and resource exhaustion are rejected as body/connectivity truth authority.
open_claims: PB-007-04 remains OPEN_PROPAGATED: MC-033 consumes independently proved connectivity/partition evidence but does not establish a universal exact topology/connectivity decision procedure for every admitted material state.
PO-07 remains OPEN under MC-032 integration ownership because the bounded state machine does not erase the universal topology/connectivity proof obligation.
RB-016-02 remains OPEN: nominal disconnected multi-body identity/lineage is explicit, but native engineering-output and independent-consumer preservation remain unqualified.
RB-016-04 remains OPEN: nominal exact-zero touch semantics are explicit, but exact-zero/touching/singular engineering-output qualification remains unproduced.
RB-016-05 remains OPEN: nominal disappearance/EMPTY_MATERIAL semantics are explicit, but downstream native/independent-consumer empty-output qualification remains unproduced.
PB-007-01, PB-007-02 and PB-007-03 remain open under their existing producing owners; MC-033 does not alter them.
MC-B, MC-C, MC-D, MC-E, MC-F and MC-1 remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
adversarial_controls: exact 1/1000000 positive parting/split witness creates a fresh descendant without dropping the explicit continuation
descendant remachining targets its durable body ID explicitly rather than largest/nearest/provider component identity
exact-zero contact records contact but cannot merge, delete or reinterpret either durable body
exact disappearance retains exhausted body/lineage history and rejects a +1/1000000 residual rounded to empty
exhausted bodies cannot be revived by later pure-removal machining
zero-volume split outputs cannot become durable material bodies
missing/unknown independent connectivity proof terminates BLOCKED rather than guessing topology
incomplete/non-disjoint component partition evidence is blocked
backend topology identity authority and pure-removal MERGE requests are rejected
duplicate/reused historical durable body or lineage identifiers are rejected
stale revisions and mutated MC-031/MC-032/MC-033 certificate bindings are rejected
RESOURCE_REFUSAL/UNCERTIFIED/BLOCKED terminals preserve the exact pre-transition state

review.disposition: completed bounded programme-owned durable-body/lineage state implementation; universal topology and downstream engineering-output qualification remain explicit blockers
review.downstream_release: MC-038 may consume MC-033 nominal body/lineage semantics and finite-history implementation. This does not release MC-B while PB-007-01/02/03/04, required POs and RB-016 evidence obligations remain open.

downstream_invalidations: Any inference of durable body or lineage identity from kernel handles, provider components, tessellation IDs, enumeration order, largest component or nearest/proximity matching invalidates MC-033.
Any body merge from exact-zero contact, any dropped positive-volume split component, any zero-volume artifact promoted to a body, or any positive residual rounded to empty invalidates MC-033.
Any stale/mutated certificate accepted, non-success terminal committed, exhausted ID reused/revived, or pure-removal material addition invalidates MC-033.
Closing PB-007-04, PO-07, RB-016-02/04/05 or promoting MC-B without independent producing-owner evidence is outside MC-033 authority.
